content:
Changes in Traffic Data Due to Artificial Intelligence

According to recent data shared by Similarweb, a decline in traffic was observed on OpenAI’s ChatGPT service following Google’s launch of its Gemini 3 model in November. Looking at December data, Gemini traffic increased by 28 percent compared to the previous month, while ChatGPT traffic decreased by 5.6 percent.

Despite this decline, ChatGPT continues to maintain its market leadership by a wide margin with 5.5 billion monthly visitors. During the same period, Gemini reached 1.7 billion visitors. It should be noted that the analyzed data covers only website visits and does not include API integrations or mobile app usage.

Competitors’ Status and Growth Rates

When evaluated on an annual basis, both platforms recorded positive growth. While ChatGPT’s traffic increased by 49.5 percent year-over-year, Gemini stood out with an aggressive growth rate of 563.6 percent. The current visitor data for other players in the sector is as follows:

  • ChatGPT: 5.5 billion visitors
  • Gemini: 1.7 billion visitors
  • Others (DeepSeek, Grok, Claude, Perplexity): Less than 400 million visitors per platform

These figures serve as a concrete indicator of the prioritization strategies discussed within OpenAI following the launch of Gemini 3, as well as the shifting market dynamics. Competition in the sector continues to be shaped not only by the technical capabilities of the models but also by their user retention rates.
